description: Find and rank schema.org entities from natural language. Returns bounded entity context with relationship IDs; use get_entity for full detail.

limit.description: Optional: maximum ranked entities to return (default 5, maximum 10)

query.description: Search terms (e.g., "AI optimisation services", "schema markup articles")

type.description: Optional: filter by entity type (Organization, Service, Article, Person, WebPage, Question)

weights.description: Optional: Custom weight multipliers for ranking

name: fuzzy_find_and_traverse
